crossRefs.note: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
“He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the…
but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has…
Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.
You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his…
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
